parent.result: LiDAR-IMU clean goals 0/12 legacy_cumulative vs 11/12 bounded_latest; stereo 0/12 in both
parent.order_audit: within_arm_counterbalanced=false: stereo always ran legacy first, LiDAR-IMU always bounded first

warmup.per: every shard (smoke and development), one per pipeline, same arm and condition as the shard (smoke: nominal)
warmup.order: same as the shard's first pair, before any smoke or scored cell
warmup.reason: each shard re-extracts scratch and starts a fresh Python process and every episode starts fresh native processes; warm-ups bring imports, EGL/GPU, page cache, recorder threads and CPU/GPU clocks to a running state on both code paths before any scored cell
warmup.exclusion: reserved seed, role=warmup, separate output tree, never in completed cells, gates, groups or pairs; collector rejects any scored row that is a warm-up

counterbalance.rule: pair(seed index i, condition index c, route index r) runs PIPELINES[(i+c+r)%2] first; shard order: warm-ups, straight pair, occluders pair

pairing: same seed/condition/route/arm; both routes of one seed/condition in one fresh shard; every pair in the same GPU allocation and process

initialization.known_start_assumption: first accepted pose anchored to nominal station, initialization movement not truth-corrected

unchanged: frozen actor, routes, native settings/thresholds, .35s capture-age cutoff, known-start registration, raw LiDAR brake, delivery quantization and no submission on arrival step
candidate: one pending latest joined camera/LiDAR event (one latest identity per stream), one in-service estimator request; all causal intervening IMU retained; selected PNG IPC plus native measured service, simulator generation and evidence separate
reference: current cumulative acquisition callback charging plus native client service; measured again in this new source with timing/identity instrumentation
evidence: candidate real single-worker queue capacity8, immutable buffers, backpressure/errors reported and joined before PASS; archive clock wall-time separate from modeled simulation time
profile: before native smoke, first40 retained stereo pairs and original cloud/IMU arrays: required PNG transport and evidence recording microbenchmark with exact decoded values/timestamp checks, no new navigation score
smoke_execution_gate: all 6 same-source/input smoke cells and 2 warm-ups execute with finite physics, native I/O and verified evidence
nominal_readiness_gate: per pipeline/arm: nominal 18 s smoke cell (warm-ups excluded) full horizon, accepted native pose, zero falls/contacts/nonfinite; scientific negative gates retain declared development cells as UNRUN
arms_decision: LiDAR-IMU only. The 48-pair budget of both arms x 4 seeds is spent on 8 seed clusters of the one estimator with a goal gain to confirm. Stereo was 0/12 in both schedules (every bounded stereo episode latched a permanent stop after native map identity was lost), so it has no goal gain to order-test, and its wrapper is being changed in a separate follow-up. Cost: the stereo stale-fraction and latency differences keep their v1 order qualification. Both arms x 8 seeds would need 51 launcher jobs, above the 32-job cap.

hypotheses.H1_primary: In LiDAR-IMU, bounded_latest yields more clean goals than legacy_cumulative in matched pairs when each schedule runs first in exactly half of the pairs and both pipelines are warmed up in every shard.
hypotheses.H2_order: Execution position within a pair (first or second) does not change clean goals or latency (secondary period-effect test).
hypotheses.H3_latency: bounded_latest lowers per-episode p95 modeled pipeline service and p95 navigation pose age relative to legacy_cumulative (secondary estimation).

primary_outcome.metric: paired clean-goal difference, bounded_latest minus legacy_cumulative, over all declared LiDAR-IMU pairs
primary_outcome.clean_goal: evaluator-trace goal within 0.30 m, full 40 s horizon, no fall, contact or nonfinite state (unchanged from v1)
primary_outcome.test: exact two-sided McNemar: scipy.stats.binomtest(bounded_only, bounded_only + legacy_only, 0.5); zero discordant pairs reported as p = 1

decision_rule.CONFIRMED: all 48 pairs measured AND McNemar p < 0.05 AND bounded_only > legacy_only AND seed-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of the goal-rate difference has lower bound > 0 AND bounded clean goals exceed legacy clean goals within each execution sequence (legacy-first pairs and bounded-first pairs separately)
decision_rule.NOT_CONFIRMED: complete cohort but any CONFIRMED condition fails; the predeclared negative result
decision_rule.INCOMPLETE_NO_VERDICT: any execution error, missing, duplicated or gate-UNRUN primary cell; no primary verdict is computed
decision_rule.ORDER_EFFECT_DETECTED: flag: first-position test or sequence-by-winner Fisher test p < 0.05 for clean goals, reported regardless of the primary verdict
decision_rule.ATTENUATED: flag: CONFIRMED but the bootstrap interval upper bound is below the v1 LiDAR-IMU difference 11/12

negative_result: NOT_CONFIRMED means the v1 0/12 -> 11/12 LiDAR-IMU gain did not survive balanced order and warm-up. An order artifact would show bounded wins concentrated in bounded-first pairs, no bounded advantage in legacy-first pairs and a significant order test. A significant excess of legacy-only pairs is reported as a reversal. Every outcome is reported beside v1; none replaces it.

statistics.per_pair: difference bounded_latest minus legacy_cumulative for clean goal, stale fraction and each latency metric
statistics.goal_rates: Wilson 95% interval per pipeline, scipy.stats.binomtest(k, n).proportion_ci(method='wilson'); episodes treated as independent
statistics.discordant_share: exact Clopper-Pearson 95% interval of bounded_only / discordant
statistics.goal_difference_interval: seed-cluster bootstrap percentile 95% interval: resample seeds with replacement keeping all pairs of a seed together; statistic is the pooled mean paired difference; exact enumeration of all multisets with multinomial weights (6435 for 8 seeds), inverted-CDF percentiles; Monte Carlo (20000 resamples, numpy seed 20261014) only above 200000 multisets
statistics.cluster_robustness: seed-level sign test on per-seed mean goal difference (binomtest, zero seeds dropped)
statistics.latency: per-pair differences of per-episode p95 modeled pipeline service (full_pipeline_p95_ms), p95 navigation pose age (navigation_pose_age_p95_ms) and p95 native client wall time (client_wall_p95_ms): mean and median with seed-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals; a pair missing a value is excluded from that metric only and counted
statistics.stale: paired stale-stop fraction difference (v1 co-primary, secondary here) with a seed-cluster bootstrap 95% interval
statistics.seed_variability: per-seed goal rates, goal difference and mean latency differences; SD (ddof=1), minimum and maximum across seeds
statistics.order_effect: first versus second position within arm: (a) discordant pairs won by the first-run pipeline, binomtest against 0.5; (b) Fisher exact test of sequence (legacy-first, bounded-first) by winner (bounded, legacy) among discordant pairs; (c) goal rate by position for each pipeline with Wilson intervals; (d) latency period effect (mean difference in bounded-first pairs minus legacy-first pairs)/2, two-sided permutation test (exact up to 200000 assignments, else 20000 resamples, numpy seed 20261014)
statistics.per_condition: goal rates and differences by condition, descriptive
statistics.multiplicity: one primary test; all other p-values are secondary and unadjusted
statistics.implementation: scripts/bench/processing_schedule_order_analysis.py on the strict collector campaign_result.json; scipy 1.15.3, numpy 1.26.0

exclusion_rules: warm-up cells are excluded by construction: reserved seed, role=warmup, raw images not archived, compact receipts in a separate output tree, never in completed cells, readiness gates, groups or pairs
no scored episode is excluded after execution; falls, contacts, early termination or nonfinite physics count as no clean goal
a pair missing a continuous metric stays in the goal analysis and is excluded from that metric only, with counts reported
cells left UNRUN by a negative nominal smoke gate are retained as UNRUN, never zero; any UNRUN primary cell gives INCOMPLETE_NO_VERDICT
stopping_rules: one allocation and one attempt: the dispatcher refuses a second submission in the campaign directory
no interim look at outcomes, no optional stopping and no seeds added after outcomes

an execution error (runner exception, evidence or hash mismatch, archive cap, quota or wall time) stops all remaining shards without retry; the campaign is INCOMPLETE and no primary verdict is computed; completed shards stay descriptive
a rerun needs a new campaign directory, a fresh smoke and this unchanged protocol
the analysis runs once, after strict collection, with the frozen analysis script

power.design_effect: seed clustering with design effect 1.5-2 lowers effective pairs: 24 -> 12-16 (half-effect power 0.48-0.75), 48 -> 24-32 (half-effect power 0.95-0.99)
power.choice: 8 new seeds (48 pairs) keep power >= 0.95 for half the v1 effect under design effect 2 and give 8 bootstrap clusters (6435 multisets) instead of 4 (35)

resources.reason: v1 ran on cn-gpu6 (Quadro RTX 8000, cascadelake); legacy modeled latency charges measured wall-clock callback cost, so hardware is pinned

budget.estimate_basis: v1 job 21801949 LiDAR-IMU runner time per episode 46/60/87 s (nominal/10 Hz/exposure), 18 s warm-ups 25-45 s, per-shard archive and dispatcher verification about 50 s; v1 LiDAR-IMU raw output 2.2 GiB per seed (4 pairs per condition x 3); warm-up images not archived

navigation_denominator: pre-step decision timestamps >=10s, actual decision count; shortened horizons explicit
scope: eight-seed within-arm counterbalanced LiDAR-IMU schedule-model confirmation in simulation; ideal simulated sensing; no hardware timing, population or stereo claims
